{{Attr|Health Regen}} (Variable) |ability1 = '''Summon''' - Slams its scythe and summons in four [[Mystery|Mysteries]], each with a 0.4 delay before another. |ability1_cooldown = 20 }} ==Description== The '''Void Reaper''' is a summoner enemy that appears in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] and [[Voidcore Mode|Voidcore]] modes. It has decent health, around the same as the [[Voidling]], but only an average speed. It has one ability where it will scythe and summon in four [[Mystery|Mysteries]]. There is a 0.4 delay between each spawn. ==Logbook Description== "''The Void Reaper hunts the wandering Souls that are created after a realm’s death. They herd them like sheep and drive the Souls into finding their individual identity once more so they can be fully incorporated into the Void army. Some Souls can be disobedient or still hold onto fragments of their past selves. If this is the case, the Void Reaper will slice the Soul in two, and they will be forever lost to the Void.''" ==Appearance== The '''Void Reaper''' has black skin, pink eyes and no legs. It floats above the path. It wears a purple robe with a hood and a brown belt with a few skulls tied to it. Its left arm. Its left arm is entirely made out of bones and it has a skull shoulder-pad with neon purple eyes there. On its chest, it has a partially exposed ribcage. On its face, it has a few flowers growing on its eyes and two horns. It carries a scythe with chains wrapped around it. ==Strategy== *High DPS towers like the [[Crook Boss]], [[Golden Minigunner]], [[Engineer]] or [[Kingpin]] can be used to take it down. **AOE towers like the [[Mortar]] or [[Rocketeer]] can be used to help clear out it and the enemies it summons. **Support towers like the [[Commander]], [[DJ Booth]] or [[Medic]] can be used to boost the DPS of your towers. *Due to its immunities, the '''Void Reaper''' cannot be frozen or chilled by freezing towers. **Similarly, stunning towers will only slow it down instead of stunning it. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Hardcore Rework Trailer - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Void Reaper''' in the game trailer. {{GalleryHeader|Concept Art}} VoidReaperCA.png|'''Void Reaper''' on its concept art. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} ModernVoidReaperIconIG.png|'''Void Reaper''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Void Reaper''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. ==Update History== *'''5 June 2026''' - [[v2.0.0]] **'''Void Reaper''' added, replacing the [[Fallen Reaper]]. *'''8 June 2026''' - [[v2.0.0|v2.0.6]] **[[Freeze Immunity]] added. {{Hardcore|[[Voidling]]|Wave 21|Void Reaper|Wave 22|[[Elite Phantom]]|Wave 23}} {{Voidcore|[[Elite Phantom]]|Wave 22|Void Reaper|Wave 23|[[Void Floater]]|Wave 25}} {{ZombieNavBox}}
